Browser-only deps replaced per rules 4/7: web <Modal> (createPortal/document/focus-trap) -> React Native <Modal> + overlay/backdrop/dialog scaffold matching the sibling ConfirmDialog/AddAnnotationPopover ports (the web Modal's hardcoded "Close" aria-label is mirrored on the native close Pressable); web <Tabs> (role=tablist DOM buttons) -> native DialogTabs using accessibilityRole tablist/tab with roving selected state and the same onChange(k => k==='totp'?'totp':'password') narrowing; web <Input>/<Button>/<HelperText>/<ErrorText> -> RN <TextInput>/Pressable DialogAction/styled <AppText>; type=password -> secureTextEntry, inputMode=numeric+pattern -> keyboardType=number-pad with the identical .replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,8) transform, autoComplete hints -> textContentType=password|oneTimeCode; data-testid -> testID for reauth-dialog/reauth-password/reauth-totp/reauth-confirm-text/reauth-error/reauth-cancel/reauth-submit.

react-i18next useTranslation -> local useNativeTranslationFallback returning the inline English fallback AND interpolating {{token}} options via Object.entries(...).split().join(), so every t(key, fallback, opts) call (sudo.title/openMode.title/description/openMode.body/tabs.*/passwordLabel/totpLabel/helper/typedConfirmationLabel/errors.*/cancel/submit/openMode.submit) keeps its key and copy — same pattern as the BrowserCompatBanner/EmptyStateThreshold ports.

@/hooks/useSessionMonitor (window.setInterval + window-focus polling, no native equivalent) -> a local useReauthSessionMode() that reads the SAME /auth/session endpoint through the native request() client and derives open/session/unknown. Only the `mode` field the dialog consumes is reproduced (the web dialog uses monitor.mode only), preserving API-path parity and the open-mode => typed-confirmation behaviour; the full countdown monitor is out of scope for this component file.

FormEvent<HTMLFormElement> submit (web rule 4 DOM-only) -> a no-arg handleSubmit invoked from the primary button's onPress; e.preventDefault() is unnecessary on native. The web's inner `const code` in submitPerUserTotp was renamed to `rawCode` to satisfy @typescript-eslint/no-shadow against the function param; behaviour is identical. The two `(err as Error & {code,status})` cast-then-assign blocks were rewritten as a single typed-cast local to drop the leading-semicolon ASI guard with no behavior change.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported.
